summary: Tow truck drivers Tom Wells and Tom Stogsdill (Wells Crested Butte Towing) were caught by an early-September snowstorm while retrieving a client's truck on Cement Creek Road; took a wrong turn in whiteout conditions into a sagebrush bowl with deep snow drifts and spent 26+ hours overnight in their truck. Western State Mountain Rescue Team searched through the night Tuesday (called off ~4:30 a.m. Sept 9); Crested Butte Mountain Rescue Team resumed ~10:30 a.m. Sept 9 with four members plus a mission coordinator (Jeep Rubicon + tracked UTV). Three helicopter agencies were unable to fly due to weather. Wells' nephew Jared Graff located the men that afternoon far up Cement Creek; both safe and uninjured.
responding_agency: Western State Mountain Rescue Team; Crested Butte Mountain Rescue Team
notes: Run 332 had excluded this incident as self-resolved (family-located); the parent-opened CBN article confirms a documented two-team SAR deployment (WSMRT overnight search + CBMRT morning redeploy with vehicles), so it qualifies as a documented SAR mission. 2020-09-08 = Tuesday, verified.
